title: Spectre: NINE EYES — Special-Agent Mission Software
description: BOND film package for Spectre (2015), mission codename NINE EYES. Six pure, deterministic analysis modules over one canonical dataset: surveillance-network data-flow centralization and betweenness (surveillance_net); criminal-organisation cell structure, hierarchy and compartmentalization (org_intel); connectivity geometry, articulation points and critical nodes (network_geometry); volume-weighted traffic interception and budgeted submodular monitoring allocation (traffic_intel); compromise cascades through the brotherhood (infiltration); and sensor-placement set cover with coverage redundancy (signal_cover). Deterministic, zero-mock, protocol-driven.
